name: ax
one_liner: Infrastructure software from Google for running huge numbers of AI agent tasks reliably on a cluster of computers, like Kubernetes but for AI agents instead of web apps.
buyer: A platform/infra engineer at a mid-size company running many automated AI agent workloads who needs them to run reliably at scale instead of as fragile scripts.
business_use_cases: A company running hundreds of daily AI research or coding agent jobs uses it to schedule and sandbox them reliably instead of ad-hoc cron jobs.
A cloud consultancy offers 'agent infrastructure setup' as a service for clients scaling past a handful of manual AI workflows.
An AI SaaS company builds its backend job-runner on top of it instead of building agent orchestration from scratch.

money_ideas.idea: Consulting/implementation services setting it up for a client's infrastructure.

steal_this: This is early-stage, breaking-changes-expected infra software for engineering teams — not a weekend consumer product; the near-term money is in implementation consulting, and even that is risky given how early it is.
